name: Hello
description: The example module: a `hello` command, an app and a widget. Copy it to start yours
author: icebreaker

name: CALENDAR
description: Your agenda: a calendar in your vault (plain Markdown, offline) and, if you want, your Google calendars, the `cal` command, the CALENDAR app and an "upcoming" HOME widget
author: icebreaker

name: HABITS
description: Daily habits: boxes that reset every day, streaks, a 2-week strip, and the numbers in STATS. Water ×8, read, stretch on mon wed fri…
author: icebreaker

name: MUSIC
description: What's playing on this computer (Spotify, Music, any player on Linux) with play / pause / skip / volume: a HOME widget and the `music` command
author: icebreaker

name: REMINDERS
description: Local reminders: a notification 15 minutes before and on time, on every system. No account, nothing online.
author: icebreaker

name: STATS
description: Numbers over time: what your modules record (budget left, commands run, notes…) and your own (weight, pages read). Graphs, a widget, and ib.stats for module makers.
author: icebreaker

name: TODO
description: A to-do list with priorities and due dates: an app, a HOME widget and the `todo` command
author: icebreaker

name: NEXUS
description: the vault as a place: a pseudo-3D carousel to fly through folders, search, rename, sort
author: icebreaker

name: UPLINK
description: your AI: LINK chat, ask and chat in the shell, the uplink widget
author: icebreaker

name: JOURNAL
description: one page a day, the daily check-in, streaks and the journal calendar
author: icebreaker

name: SYSMON
description: the machine's vitals: cpu, memory, processes
author: icebreaker

name: THEME STUDIO
description: every knob of the current theme, with a live preview
author: icebreaker

name: VOICE
description: the deck's voice: local text-to-speech through a robot filter
author: icebreaker

name: NEWS
description: headlines for your area or a topic, with summaries
author: icebreaker

name: WEATHER
description: now, the next 24 h and the week (open-meteo.com)
author: icebreaker

name: CLOCKS
description: the clock, world clocks, a timer and a stopwatch
author: icebreaker

name: FOCUS
description: a pomodoro timer
author: icebreaker

name: MOON
description: tonight's moon and the next phases
author: icebreaker

name: MATRIX
description: digital rain on HOME: does nothing, looks great
author: icebreaker

name: QUOTES
description: a line to think about, every hour
author: icebreaker

name: BreakerMED (beta)
description: A tracker like OctaMED and ProTracker: .med and .mod songs (and its own .bmed), 8 to 16 tracks, a sampler, analog, FM and chip synths (NES, Game Boy, C64-style…), a drum machine, chords, exports to WAV, FLAC, MP3… — in ASCII, keyboard, mouse and gamepad
author: icebreaker
